errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the positions of the largest and smallest slices. The largest slice (green, 51%) occupies the entire bottom half of the chart, not just the bottom-left quadrant. The smallest slice (blue, 3%) is at the top of the chart, while the slice in the top-left quadrant is the purple one (23%).
